note: Every public source found for com.instagram.android, with the branches and commits it was last read at, its licence and what HushGram may take from it, plus the two Facebook sources HushGram's shared code came from. scripts/instagram-sources.ps1 holds it to its rules and scripts/audit-instagram-sources.ps1 refreshes it. docs/sources.md is the readable version.

features: Shared extension and in-app settings screen
entries.reason: HushGram's scaffold, from the same author. The shared extension, the settings screen, the link cleaner and the re-signed build fix were copied from its commit c15d4f79 and renamed for Instagram, and all six of HushGram's patches applied unforced to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84. It patches Facebook, not Instagram, so only the files HushGram took are watched. The video and photo save pipeline came later, from its commit 3a473639, as a core that takes plain inputs, with its Facebook hooks left out. Its commit 814acd23 gave the release scripts and the Tap to play and Resume long videos rules (TapClock, TapToPlay, ResumePlayback, ResumePoints), so those files are watched too, and so are PlaybackQuality and QualityChoice, the quality ladder and choice rules behind Default playback quality from its commit 830f9499.

Where the re-signed build fix and the external browser patch started. HushGram's Restore trust and its signature helper came through Hushfacebook from Andrew Liang's commit 5db2e57e, and apply unforced to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84. Open links in external browser came the same way, from the same commit. The bundle patches Facebook and LINE, so only those two fixes and their helpers are watched.

features: Hide group creation button on sharesheet
entries.reason: The biggest Instagram source by far, GPL-3.0 with a NOTICE that asks for attribution under GPL section 7(b). Its 3.10.0-dev.9 build applies all 60 Instagram patches to 439.0.0.37.89 but only 5 to 449.0.0.52.84, because Add settings misses its NativeSwitchInitializer fingerprint and the rest depend on it. HushGram reads it for behavior and anchors and carries none of its code. It carried two of its data files from commit ea752648 (the MetaConfig name list for 447 and the recommended flag list) until Open developer options was removed in October 2026, so nothing of it ships now.
